Agent Name: WaybackMachine_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent hallucinated the specific content of the menu items (Roast Chicken, Grilled Salmon, etc.) when it could not retrieve the actual data from the Wayback Machine due to a connection timeout. Instead of reporting the failure or searching for a valid snapshot, the agent fabricated the menu lists to proceed, leading to the incorrect identification of "shrimp and grits" (and the wrong singular form "shrimp and grits" instead of just "shrimp" as requested by the output format).
